_about: Three anomaly materials of the ported 0.21 maps take 0.21d's own look back. The port gives a ported material the values of 0.26g's material of the same name; for these three 0.26g redesigned the anomaly, so the 0.21 maps showed 0.26g's (the owner's screenshots of 2026-11-18: Fort's crystals red, Rudnya's swamp anomaly "moving too fast"). uran_crystals (Fort's crystals; 0.21d: green, a faint glow): numbers only, the glow's multiplier 1 -> 0.21d's 0.1, its flicker's intensity 1 -> 0, no scroll of the glow map along u, fresnel 0.4 -> 0.04. Its switches (flicker, subsurface scattering and its mask, the specular-intensity map, vegetation) stay as 0.26g has them: with them off the material asks for gbuffer_pass.ps/_3___1100_00001_00____1_____0__0_00000____00100____000__________0__, which 0.26g never shipped, and the game stops at Fort's load (candidate 19, 2026-11-18). cloud_mesh (Rudnya's swamp anomaly clouds): no uv distortion and no emissive map, neither of which 0.21d's has. anomaly_stalactite: no emissive flicker. Values read from retail 0.21d's material_instances of the same names; the native materials are untouched (these are the ported/v021d copies).
